NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Passer connects to your PC over Wi-Fi to send and receive your clipboard, photos and files. Nothing leaves your local network.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Passer uses the camera to scan the pairing code shown on your PC.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Passer saves the images you receive from your PC to your photo library.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Passer reads your latest screenshots and photos when you run one of its Shortcuts actions, to send them to your PC.
